Interface\levelupmenu.swf - the skill-point level-up menu

This file is Static Skill Leveling Rewritten's vanilla-look level-up menu (Nexus 89940, version 1.8,
by RookMeister, noyou and Kredje), included with its authors' permission: the mod's permissions grant
modification and asset use without asking, and its FAQ says "do what you want with sources". It is
unchanged. Character Progression Control drives it from its DLL instead of Papyrus: the DLL feeds it
the caps, the settings and the player's skills when it opens, and applies the allocation it sends back.

If you use a UI replacer, Static Skill Leveling Rewritten's other skins of this same menu (Nordic,
Untarnished, Dear Diary) fit the same contract - install one of them over this file.
